title: What 1fr really means
why_it_matters: The fr unit is the easiest way to mix fixed and flexible columns.
explanation: 1fr is one share of the leftover space, not a fixed size. Fixed columns take their space first. Whatever remains is split by fr values. A sidebar of 240px beside a 1fr column gives you a content area that always fills the rest.
try_it: Try 1fr 2fr instead. Predict the widths before you check them in DevTools.
